WCAG 2.2 AA Validation, Static Web Portals & Auto-VPAT 2.5

WCAG 2.2 AA Validation, Static Web Portals & Auto-VPAT 2.5

Accessibility for end users is never paywalled across any edition of RaggieSoft Help Studio.

Compile-Time Accessibility & Integrity Gates

  • RSH015: Detects skipped heading levels (<h1> directly to <h3>).
  • RSH020: Blocks unlabeled <img> elements missing alt attributes.
  • RSH025: Warns on unscrubbed Word MsoNormal or color:black styles that break Dark Mode.
  • RSH030 & RSH040: Catches broken topic links and duplicate numeric F1 Context IDs.
  • RSH055: Verifies AccentPrimaryHex achieves >= 4.5:1 contrast against #FFFFFF button captions and >= 3.0:1 against #15203A Dark Mode cards.

Automated HTML5 VPAT 2.5 Conformance Report

Pass --with-vpat to rshbuild.exe (or enable VPAT 2.5 in HelpStudio.exe) to emit a standalone HTML5 Accessibility Conformance Report (Revised Section 508 & WCAG 2.2 Level AA) covering both your desktop F1 viewer and static web documentation portal.
